intent: Read-only block of code with a copy button, optional title, language label, tabs, and line numbers. No syntax highlighting.
useWhen: Showing a command, config, or code sample the reader will copy
Install or usage snippets in docs, onboarding, or developer settings
Several variants of one snippet (npm / pnpm, React / HTML) behind tabs
doNotUseWhen: A short inline token or path inside a sentence — use a <code> element in body text
Secrets the user must not see in full (API keys) — mask them before passing code

code.note: required unless tabs is set; ignored when tabs is set

tabs.note: renders kit Tabs (line, sm) in the header; a tab's language wins over language

language.note: label in the header only; no highlighting

title.note: filename or caption in the header; with tabs it only names the code region

copyable.note: kit Button sm: tertiary in the header, secondary in its own column beside the code when there is no header, so text never scrolls under it. Copy -> Copied for 1.2s

a11y.element: pre > code inside a div role=region
requirements: The region is named by title, the active tab label, or the language
The region is focusable (tabIndex 0) only when it scrolls, so keyboard users can scroll it
Copy button is named by its visible text (Copy, then Copied); a polite live region announces Copied
Line numbers are aria-hidden and user-select none; copy writes the raw code string
Tabs follow kit Tabs keyboard (arrows, Home, End)

doNot: Do not invent a local code block; use kit CodeSnippet
Do not add a syntax highlighting dependency
Do not use raw hex or a local monospace font; use type.family.code
Do not put line numbers into the code string
snippet:
<CodeSnippet title="install.sh" language="bash" code="npm install agentic-ds-kit" />
<CodeSnippet
  tabs={[
    { label: "npm", code: "npm install agentic-ds-kit" },
    { label: "pnpm", code: "pnpm add agentic-ds-kit" }
  ]}
/>
